description: Create a Qwen Image task on RunAPI (text to image). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Declared type: string. Known values: "1:1", "3:4", "9:16", "4:3", "16:9".

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for asynchronous task updates. Declared type: string.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

output_format.description: Output image format. Declared type: string. Known values: "png", "jpeg".

prompt.description: Image generation prompt. Declared type: string.

seed.description: Integer seed for reproducible results. Declared type: integer.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: text_to_image
